title: Water · disinfection bench
sop: Critical or latched protection: escalate without an action.
For noncritical elevated residual with good flow, propose a bounded lower target.
Wait for mixing and measurement response before another adjustment.

checks.verify_sensor: Compare the residual sensor with an independent reading.
checks.verify_protection: Verify critical alarms and latched protection with the operator.

relationships: Target changes feed the baseline regulator; measured residual approaches the target over time.
No flow or an active override invalidates routine adjustment.
